violations.text:
Bathroom located inside establishment not completely enclosed with tight-fitting, self-closing doors.
Women and men's restroom

Ceiling tile missing.
In men's restroom. Operator states they just had repairs made
Current Hotel and Restaurant license not displayed.

Time/temperature control for safety food thawed in an improper manner.
Bags of meat thawing in sink. Advised to turn on water

Wet wiping cloth not stored in sanitizing solution between uses.
Employee moved
2 Small Live, small flying insects found at bar.

Handwash sink used for purposes other than handwashing.
Used to store beer mugs. Employee moved

No proof provided that food employees are informed of their responsibility to report to the person in charge information about their health and activities related to foodborne illnesses.
All new employees less than 30 days. Provided form, employees signed

Food stored on floor.
Plastic water bottles behind front counter stored on floor

Standing water in bottom of reach-in-cooler.
Beer coolers at bar

Hot time/temperature control for safety food received at less than 135 degrees Fahrenheit.
cooked chicken (122-133F - Hot Holding); ground beef (98F - Hot Holding)
In steam table for 3 hours. Operator moved to reheat to 165f.

No paper towels or mechanical hand drying device provided at handwash sink.
Bar hand sink needs paper towels

Ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food prepared onsite and held more than 24 hours not properly date marked.
red salsa made 3 days ago. Advised to add date to container

Nonfood-contact surface soiled with grease, food debris, dirt, slime or dust.
Hood filters soiled in grease
Standing water in bottom of beer coolers at bar

Time/temperature control for safety food, other than whole meat roast, hot held at less than 135 degrees Fahrenheit.
shredded chicken (131F - Hot Holding)
Advised manager to reheat. 2nd temp 144f
